description: Defines the PreProcessingContext class and related enums for managing audio preprocessing effects in Android's audio effect framework.

classes.name: PreProcessingContext
classes.description: Manages the state and configuration of a specific audio preprocessing effect, including echo cancellation, automatic gain control, noise suppression, and processing state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the preprocessing context with given parameters.

methods.name: deInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the preprocessing context.

methods.name: getPreProcessingType
methods.description: Returns the type of preprocessing effect.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the preprocessing effect.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the preprocessing effect.

methods.name: setCommon
methods.description: Sets common parameters for the effect.

methods.name: updateConfigs
methods.description: Updates configuration parameters.

methods.name: setAcousticEchoCancelerEchoDelay
methods.description: Sets the echo delay for acoustic echo cancellation.

methods.name: getAcousticEchoCancelerEchoDelay
methods.description: Gets the current echo delay setting.

methods.name: setAcousticEchoCancelerMobileMode
methods.description: Sets whether the echo canceler operates in mobile mode.

methods.name: getAcousticEchoCancelerMobileMode
methods.description: Gets the current mobile mode setting.

methods.name: setAutomaticGainControlV1TargetPeakLevel
methods.description: Sets the target peak level for AGC V1.

methods.name: getAutomaticGainControlV1TargetPeakLevel
methods.description: Gets the target peak level for AGC V1.

methods.name: setAutomaticGainControlV1MaxCompressionGain
methods.description: Sets the maximum compression gain for AGC V1.

methods.name: getAutomaticGainControlV1MaxCompressionGain
methods.description: Gets the maximum compression gain for AGC V1.

methods.name: setAutomaticGainControlV1EnableLimiter
methods.description: Enables or disables limiter in AGC V1.

methods.name: getAutomaticGainControlV1EnableLimiter
methods.description: Checks if limiter is enabled in AGC V1.

methods.name: setAutomaticGainControlV2DigitalGain
methods.description: Sets digital gain for AGC V2.

methods.name: getAutomaticGainControlV2DigitalGain
methods.description: Gets digital gain for AGC V2.

methods.name: setAutomaticGainControlV2LevelEstimator
methods.description: Sets the level estimator for AGC V2.

methods.name: getAutomaticGainControlV2LevelEstimator
methods.description: Gets the level estimator for AGC V2.

methods.name: setAutomaticGainControlV2SaturationMargin
methods.description: Sets the saturation margin for AGC V2.

methods.name: getAutomaticGainControlV2SaturationMargin
methods.description: Gets the saturation margin for AGC V2.

methods.name: setNoiseSuppressionLevel
methods.description: Sets the noise suppression level.

methods.name: getNoiseSuppressionLevel
methods.description: Gets the current noise suppression level.

methods.name: lvmProcess
methods.description: Processes audio data through the effect.
